title: NeuroBreak: Unveil Internal Jailbreak Mechanisms in Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper presents a visual analytics system, NeuroBreak, for analyzing the internal mechanisms of jailbreak attacks in LLMs. While the goal of the safety alignment it explores is to prevent 'unethical' outputs, the paper's focus is on the technical and mechanistic analysis of neurons and layer-wise representations rather than benchmarking or evaluating religion, morals, or ethical frameworks themselves.
